### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **99** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **14** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**73** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67`.

⛔ **17** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **14** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `recordId (4 routes)`
- **3** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `organization_id (literal, 38 pages)`, `os serve (command, 41 pages)`, `os validate (command, 75 pages)`
- **23** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **158** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4f2c6a2f9b431afdf4088ddca718bf4c8feeb535` — the merge of head `8f07f5cb1cd03b0fc37c03c192fb7b081a38f3ab` into base `6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4f2c6a2f9b431afdf4088ddca718bf4c8feeb535 && git checkout 4f2c6a2f9b431afdf4088ddca718bf4c8feeb535
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67 8f07f5cb1cd03b0fc37c03c192fb7b081a38f3ab && git checkout -B drift-repro 6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67 && git merge --no-ff 8f07f5cb1cd03b0fc37c03c192fb7b081a38f3ab

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6390fe52cecd263f09225d0d6d9b74412d111a67` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c33b95d89fa4a66dd871a0ab617f49bf870421e9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/storage-service.ts, packages/spec/src/data/index.ts, packages/spec/src/data/seed-file.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md + packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-files.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts, packages/services/service-storage/src/field-file-service.ts, packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-storage/src/file-reference-lifecycle.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/bundle-seed-files.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts, packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts, packages/cli/test/normalized-call-sites.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/{contracts,data}.json, packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json, packages/spec/declaration-map/data.json, packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/data.json, packages/spec/liveness/seed.json, content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx, .changeset/25779-seed-files.md. The rest of the diff (tests, generated references, ledgers, llms.txt, engine-double pin) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Inputs: card #25779 (body + all 7 comments, including the claim 6415670720, the claim amendment 6421695515 and both dev reports), PR #26244 (body, 55-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), and the 48 check-runs on the head. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run. Rendered 2026-10-26T19:12Z.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and public-surface changes the diff implies, each judged against the cited code:

1. **`@objectstack/spec/data` widens** — 11 new exports (`seedFile`, `isSeedFileReference`, `isSeedFilePath`, `SeedFilePathSchema`/`SeedFilePath`, `SeedFileReferenceSchema`/`SeedFileReference`/`SeedFileReferenceParsed`, `SeedFileContentSchema`/`SeedFileContent`/`SeedFileContentParsed`) via `data/index.ts`; `api-surface/data.json` lists exactly those 11. **Right.**
2. **`Seed` schema widens** — `records` values may now be `{ $file, name?, contentType? }` (alone or as elements of an array); a new optional `files` map keyed by `SeedFilePathSchema`. `authorable-surface/data.json` adds `data/Seed:files` plus the 3 + 4 child keys; `json-schema.manifest` adds the three schemas; `declaration-map` adds the three pairs. `files` is authorable (the loader's refusal text names the hand-written-dataset path), consistent with the schema. **Right.**
3. **`Seed.records` narrows at parse** — `SeedRecordValueSchema` refuses an object that CLAIMS `$file` but is malformed (unknown key, a path with a `.`/`..`/empty segment, leading `/`, drive letter or `\`), where `z.unknown()` used to accept it. The path regex refuses every case the changeset lists and accepts `.hidden/x` and `..foo` correctly. The refinement is dropped from JSON Schema and registered in `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`. **Right** (a value that had no meaning before; it is still a narrowing and the changeset says so).
4. **`defineSeed` narrows at call time** — `assertSeedFilesOnFileFields` throws for `seedFile(...)` on a field whose `type` is not in `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` (`image, file, avatar, video, audio`, on `main`). A field the object does not declare is left to `assertSeedKeysDeclared`. **Right.**
5. **`@objectstack/spec/contracts` widens** — `FIELD_FILE_SERVICE = 'field-files'`, `IFieldFileService` (`storeFile`/`describeFiles`/`claimFiles`), `StoreFieldFileInput`, `StoredFieldFile`, `FieldFileSlot`, `FieldFileDescription`; `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` carry the 6. The implementation in `field-file-service.ts` honours the documented envelope: 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 413 via `uploadSizeRefusal` before any write, 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (never a transfer), 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`; write order is row-then-bytes with the pending row deleted on a failed upload; `claimFiles` releases the slot's other files through the lifecycle's own `releaseOwnership` (only `export` added to it and `ownedBySlot`). Registered in `storage-service-plugin.ts` `init` with the engine read per call, so it serves a seed that runs in a plugin's `start()`. `providesServices` gains `field-files`. **Right.**
6. **Seed-load accept set narrows (shape 3, the card's ask #2)** — `seed-files.ts#prepareRow`: when a file-class field holds no `$file` reference and the load has a `field-files` service, every element matching `isFileIdToken` (`/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/`, on `main`) must resolve through `describeFiles` in the row's organization, else the row is refused before any write, counted in `errored`/`allErrors` and logged at `error`. URLs, inline values and a composition without the service are written as before. The organization is read off `record['organization_id']`, which the loader stamps at `seed-loader.ts:1513` on `main`, above the hunk anchor (1867), so it is final when judged. The changeset's BREAKING paragraph describes exactly this set. **Right.**
7. **Seed-load accept set widens (the card's ask #1)** — a `$file` reference is checked against the dataset's `files` entry (present, `size`, `sha256`), stored as a `pending` `sys_file` with provenance `{ seedFile, sha256 }`, the id written into the field (array for `multiple`), and the slot claimed after the row lands on every write site (insert, batched insert/update, skipped replay). Idempotent: a held file with the same path, digest, name and type and the same (or no) owner is kept; each held file serves once, so 300 rows naming one path get 300 files. Refusals by row: missing bytes, digest mismatch, no service, a mixed field, several refs in a one-file field, a store failure. A refused row stores nothing (every field is judged before any `storeFile`). Replay reads use `RAW_FILE_VALUES_CONTEXT_KEY` so held ids are compared in stored form. **Right**, and it matches the ruling hotclm#19 D (loader carries the fixture; `file` stays required).
8. **`SeedLoaderService` constructor widens** — optional 4th argument `{ getFieldFiles }`, exported as `SeedLoaderServiceOptions`; all five platform callers pass it (`app-plugin.ts` x3, `domains/packages.ts`, `protocol.ts` → `applySeedBodies`). Absent, a seed-file row is refused by name and shape 3 is not judged. **Right.**
9. **Inline boot seed readiness narrows** — an AppPlugin inline seed whose datasets carry `files` defers to `kernel:bootstrapped`, as the `demoStaff` branch already does, so files land in the adapter the `storage` settings select at `kernel:ready`. **Right.**
10. **CLI** — `collectSeedFiles` is the gate (`os validate` step 3d and `os build` step 4a refuse the same three cases: climbs out of the config's directory, names no file, type untellable and undeclared), `placeSeedFiles` the assembly (`os build` only). `os serve`/`os dev` on a config mirrors collection and only warns; the loader then refuses the row. The parity ledger classifies `collectSeedFiles` as a shared non-registry gate and `placeSeedFiles` as assembly; the call-site ledger classifies the `stack.data` read. **Right.**
11. **Governed line** — `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` +1 line, the `gen:skill-refs` row for the new module; `check:skill-refs` runs in the green Lint lanes, so it is byte-exact regeneration. It stays a Tier H path per the claim amendment. **Right.**
12. **Docs** — `seed-data.mdx` "File Fields" section states path rule, build/validate/serve behaviour, per-row files, replay keep and the three refusals; each sentence matches the cited code. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/25779-seed-files.md` at the head: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cli` all **`minor`**; these are exactly the five published packages the diff moves. `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: the diff both adds (`$file`, `files`) and narrows (shape 3 refusal; malformed `$file` refused at parse), and `narrowed` wins over `added`. `(narrowing)` is BREAKING: the title carries `!`, the body carries the **BREAKING** banner, the FROM → TO fix ("replace the value with `seedFile(path)` or remove it") and exactly one ADR-0087 marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, which is correct — no authorable key is removed, renamed or re-shaped, so there is no tombstone to ship. A kind takes at least `minor`; no package takes `major`. **Matches what the diff publishes.** `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
- The `Clause-②:` line on the changeset matches the amended claim (6421695515). The PR **body** still reads `Clause-②: yes` / `Metadata-protocol: added` — see ③.
- Not `skip-changeset`: correct, every one of the five packages publishes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag: declaration lines.** Measured narrowing, claim said `yes`/`added`. Answered: the claim was amended (6421695515) and the changeset now carries `yes (narrowing)` / `narrowed` (6c5c49cc). The PR body still carries the claim's original `yes` / `added` and is out of step with the changeset it ships; the seat has said it will patch the body after this review. This record judges the changeset; the body mismatch is noted and left to the seat.
- **Dev flag: file surface beyond the claim** (`os validate`, the `os serve` config-boot mirror, the two CLI ledgers, the runtime callers, the contract file). Judged in ① items 5, 8 and 10: each is required for the card's acceptance and none widens past the ruling. Answered.
- **Dev flag: gate-driven additions** (strictness-ledger row, ADR-0122 `Parsed` aliases and the alias pin 789 → 790, engine-double pin regenerated, dropped-refinements baseline, level-1 description pin 30 → 31). Mechanical consequences of a new `*.zod.ts` module; the gates that read them are green. Answered.
- **Dev flag: dogfood and the full sweep ran on `b8fe94f8`, not the head.** The head's CI check-runs cover the final tree (Test Core 8/8, Dogfood Regression Gate, Spec property liveness, all Lint lanes, Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer/source/debt all `success`). Answered by the check-runs.
- **Not in the check-runs:** the two end-to-end suites that are the card's acceptance (`build-seed-files-artifact.e2e.test.ts`, `serve-config-boot-seed-files.e2e.test.ts`) are nightly-tier and did not run on this head in CI. The dev reports 3/3 passing locally with the negative control (0 rows without the serve mirror, 2 with). Noted for the maintainer; not a FAIL ground, since every PR-tier gate on the head is green and the unit suites (loader 16, storage 9, CLI 8 + ledgers, spec 51) cover each claimed behaviour by name.
- **`open_questions` (report 6424852503, one entry):** the tsc heap OOM on `Type Check · workspace` (job 121738515222) and its roll-up `TypeScript Type Check` (121747810706), exit 134 in `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server`, no type error, same lane green on 6c5c49cc with identical types. Escalated: it is filed as #26288 and is not this PR's defect. These two check-runs are **NOT MEASURED** for this record — they are not a type verdict either way. Option A (re-run once) is the seat's call; option B (`skipLibCheck` in plugin-hono-server) would widen this PR past the card and belongs in its own PR. The PR's own typing is otherwise measured by the three green Type Check sub-lanes, Build Core and Test Core.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`:** the OOM margin finding (class a) is carried by #26288. Nothing else outstanding.
- **Standing on the PR:** one review exists, APPROVED by `os-zhuang` on 6c5c49cc (not dismissed). Whether that is the Tier H `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` word is the queue guard's reading and the maintainer's, not this record's; this record is the contract-tier review the route owes, and Tier H landing still waits on the maintainer per Prime Directive 14.
- **Gate tally on `c33b95d8`:** 48 check-runs — 39 `success`, 7 `skipped` (opt-in/UI matrix lanes), 2 `failure` (the NOT MEASURED pair above). `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and every scoped Lint lane are green.

## 维护者速读 — PR #26244 at `c33b95d89fa4a66dd871a0ab617f49bf870421e9`

**改了什么**：种子数据可以给文件类字段填写应用包自带的文件，写法是 `seedFile('fixtures/x.pdf')`。`os build` 构建时把文件打进产物；启动时，种子加载器把文件存进存储服务，并把记录登记为文件的归属。新增一条拒绝规则：文件字段里如果写了一个像文件 id 的值，却查不到对应的文件，这一行会被拒绝。

**为什么改**：执行维护者在 hotclm#19 的裁定 D。改之前，带必填文件字段的对象无法用种子数据填充。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：这是破坏性收窄（`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`，版本级别 minor），本仓库没有种子受影响。产物会增大，增量约为样例文件大小的 4/3。回滚直接 revert 本 PR，不涉及数据迁移。

**席位意见**：建议合入。契约复核 6425043305 判 PASS，席位核对见下文，全部通过。

**你要做的**：只有一件事，就是对 Lint & Type Check 运行 40370187707 点「Re-run failed jobs」。这一项红是 tsc 内存溢出，见 #26288。os-zhuang 的批准（在 `6c5c49cc` 上）已经在案。重跑转绿后，由席位转为 ready 并经合并队列落地。

## 席位核对

Seat `domain:spec#4`, session `session_01HbmCEPMBmMLU3VZCEzfec7`, 2026-10-26T19:14Z.

1. **Shape.** The PR is a draft against base `main`, and its first line is `Fixes #25779`, which is right because the whole card is delivered. The title carries `!`. The body's declaration lines were patched to match the changeset and amendment 6421695515.
2. **Premise, measured.** Ruling D of hotclm#19 is implemented as written. The only in-repo producer with file fields, app-showcase, seeds none, so the narrowing reaches no producer.
3. **Gates and check-runs.** At `c33b95d8`, 39 check-runs succeeded and 7 were skipped. `Type Check · workspace` and its roll-up `TypeScript Type Check` are NOT MEASURED: tsc ran out of heap in plugin-hono-server (exit 134, no type error), which is #26288's class. The relay cannot re-run that workflow, because it is not `ci.yml`. The dev's local results at this head: dispatch-gates 139 of 140, with `dual-build-cjs-loads` left to CI; dogfood 297 of 300 files (VERDICT 0); spec tests 21,995 passed.
4. **Accepted deviations.** The declaration lines are corrected in place of the claim's lines. The two nightly-tier e2e acceptance suites did not run in CI. The dev ran them 3/3 locally, with a negative control.
5. **Out of scope.** The typecheck OOM margin is filed as #26288. No other findings.
6. **Landing.** This is Tier H: a governed `skills/**` generated line, which the #11705 exception did not lift, and 3,402 changed lines. GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval os-zhuang APPROVED stands on `6c5c49cc`. Once the type-check lane is green, the owning seat flips the PR ready and arms auto-merge. A merge by the maintainer is the other way to land it.
